'''Culan Brasli''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an enforcer for the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] and knew how to maximize pain while minimizing long-term damage to those he interrogated. He had met [[Ghitsa Dogder]] several times during different circumstances before having to interrogate he aboard the [[Rook (720 light freighter)|''Rook'']] seeking information on [[Durga Besadii Tai]]'s dealing for the Desilijic. After the rescue of Ghitsa by [[Fenig Nabon]] and [[Kyp Durron]], Brasli was killed when the ''Rook'' took off and was destroyed.
